paragraphs.source_en: When Honda Masanobu arrived with Ieyasu’s sixth son, Tadateru, Kōdai-in could scarcely believe her eyes. Tadateru wore a splendid robe patterned with distant mountains and trailing mist; he seemed the very image of that gallant young warrior who had dazzled the youthful Kōdai-in long ago—Mori Ranmaru, the cherished favorite of Lord Nobunaga.
